_s9d_atlases_basis: 1.21.9 moved every atlas into AtlasManager and removed TextureAtlasHolder with PaintingTextureManager, MapDecorationTextureManager and GuiSpriteManager (javap: absent from the 1.21.9 jar). The four come back as facades with 1.21.8's bodies (facade/TextureAtlasHolder ...); Minecraft's getters for them, getTextureAtlas and the three session getters moved into Services come back on Minecraft (mixin/CbMinecraftRestoredMixin); SpriteLoader.loadAndStitch's default and Collection overloads and Preparations.waitForUpload come back on their classes (CbSpriteLoaderRestoredMixin, CbSpritePreparationsRestoredMixin). AtlasSet with StitchResult / AtlasEntry come back as a facade with 1.21.8's bodies (facade/AtlasSet); ModelManager's getAtlas / updateMaxMipLevel / close come back over the AtlasManager it is given (CbModelManagerRestoredMixin), EntityRendererProvider.Context.getModelManager with 1.21.8's body (CbEntityRendererContextRestoredMixin). Left open: new ModelManager(textureManager, blockColors, mipLevel) and its 1.21.8 reload(barrier, manager, ...) -- 1.21.9's ModelManager stitches nothing itself and reloads from the AtlasManager's stitch published in the shared reload state, which a ModelManager reloaded alone has no AtlasManager to publish.
